{Compendium of Magic}

Allows hero to cast all spells in existence on expert level and summons four types of third upgrade elementals.

You were hunting down some game for dinner when a black dragon suddenly appeared and pinned you to the ground with its giant paw. His hot breath burned your skin. The dragon noisily inhaled through his nostrils. Well, that's it! It seems that you are finished... But the monster said: 'You are the chosen one! I'll have to look for breakfast elsewhere.' The dragon soared up, leaving you unharmed. Rising up, you found the Compendium of Magic at your feet.

artifact.third-upgrades.summoningGuide.e: When you were busy preparing for your modest meal, a man approached you and introduced himself as a seller of foreign books. He was desperately trying to sell you his first book. Out of curiosity, you decided to take a look at what he had, and immediately realized that this fool had no idea what he owned. You agreed to buy one tome from him for a few pieces of silver and, advising him to do something else, you left, holding the Summoning Guide in your hands.
